headword: {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}
gloss: doing a roaring trade; a constant stream of customers

definitions.gloss: a constant stream of customers; doing a roaring trade
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing a shop or business visited by an endless flow of customers. Literally 'a thousand guests, ten thousand comings.'

examples.japanese: {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大繁盛|だいはんじょう}だ。
examples.english: Customers keep pouring in and business is booming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新装開店|しんそうかいてん}→新装開店：29977_shinsoukaiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧にぎわいだった。
examples.english: The newly reopened shop was bustling with a constant stream of customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}→招き猫：06538_manekineko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that placing a beckoning cat brings a steady flood of customers.

notes:
A celebratory idiom used to describe or wish for a business thronged with customers. Frequently appears alongside ⟦{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}→商売繁盛：29953_shoubaihanjou⟧ on lucky charms and shop decorations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧: to wish for a stream of customers
- {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧にぎわい: bustle of endless customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}→商売繁盛：29953_shoubaihanjou⟧: prosperous business — emphasizes overall commercial success rather than the crowd of customers itself
